newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Autrey says acquires Drogueros.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Autrey says acquires Drogueros.

text.p: Mexican pharmaceutical distributor Grupo Casa Autrey SA de CV said on Wednesday that it has acquired Drogueros SA de CV pending approval by the Federal Competition Commission.
Autrey said in a press release that it will pay cash for Drogueros, which it called Mexico's fourth largest pharaceutical wholesale distributor but did not disclose a sale price.
The deal is expected to be made final by August, Autrey said.
Drogueros had net sales of 1.226 billion pesos in 1996, representing about five percent of Mexico's private pharmaceutical market, Autrey said.
Autrey reported revenues of 6.64 billion pesos in 1996.
